annotations.title: Get the geology at a point

description: Use when the user asks what the geology is at a point in Western Australia. Returns the GSWA 1:500k unit and its place in its 1:250k sheet's stratigraphic column (map2loop: above, below, nearest contact and its type), the nearest fault (name, length, azimuth, the units either side), distance to geological features, petrophysics, and the litho2strat stratigraphy. Tenure, mines, holes and geochemistry around a point come from inspect_point.
name: get_geology_at_point
title: Get the geology at a point
